newsitem.title: USA: Greenspan gives same prepared testimony to Senate.
newsitem.headline: Greenspan gives same prepared testimony to Senate.

text.p: Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's prepared testimony Wednesday to the Senate Banking Committee was the same as he gave to a House Banking subcommittee on Tuesday.
Greenspan on Tuesday said growth in the economy had moderated and suggested that any rise in interest rates to head off inflation would not be needed in the near future.
His remarks Tuesday prompted a rally in stock and bond markets and investors will be watching carefully Greenspan's answers to questions from the Senate panel for any perceived change in his stance.
